title: Chrome print slicing of a framed explainer (page-1 gap, near-blank pages)
reason: the iframe prints as one unbreakable block, so the frame starts on page 2; a frame ending 7-20px past a page foot gives a near-blank page; some documents get a blank page after the colophon; cosmetic paper waste, predates F4, not truncation
